interaction: Front-only pointer/touch lighting in hero; native vertical scroll reveals the backprint, adds a restrained zoom, raises the physical ring and reveals the signup.
layout: Modern DM Sans hierarchy with no monospace or terminal tracking. Large readable email input, rounded high-contrast CTA. Short headline: Jetzt eintragen für 15 %!

states.hero: Frontal hoodie. Horizontal pointer/touch controls only the light. No pointer-driven rotation.
states.scroll: Pinned stage, native page scroll scrubs the prepared Higgsfield sequence; the ring rises and tilts to illuminate from above.
states.end: Backprint slightly closer, desktop garment left and signup right; mobile backprint above signup. Offer appears only near the completed turn.

turn.source: Higgsfield Kling 3.0 approved take, 0.75–6 seconds, full back view for the new scroll flow
turn.background: Neutral studio background removed with a connected-component matte; one fixed camera/crop
turn.transport: All frames decoded before activation, four concurrent requests; only one GPU garment texture. No video seeking or asynchronous frame replacement during interaction.
turn.mapping: Native scroll is the only garment pose input; damped monotonic frame selection. Front hold, turn, light zoom, then signup reveal.
turn.fallback: Static rear poster and usable signup if frames fail or reduced motion is requested; no wheel or vertical touch interception.

ring.material: White emission, KHR_materials_emissive_strength=12; WebGL white core plus occlusion-aware Gaussian bloom
ring.modifications: PCA alignment, center and scale normalization, texture replacement with emission
ring.surface_cleanup: Precision circular tube remesh, 512 segments x 32 sides. Smooth interpolated normals and white emission with subtle rounded cross-section falloff; no image texture. Up to 2x device pixel ratio plus zoom allowance, 2x offscreen supersampling and four-tap area resolve. Bloom is added outside the tube to preserve its rounded profile.
ring.scroll_motion: Ring rises above the centered hood, tilts 56 degrees from its initial vertical plane and reduces radius from .59 to .38. Pointer displacement reaches zero at the halo endpoint. A reserved gap separates the tube from the hood.

rendering: Perspective ring mesh with emission and occlusion-aware bloom, masked by the current Higgsfield garment frame. Garment has a reserved halo margin and an illustrative directional light approximation. The garment turn is pre-rendered, not realtime cloth physics.
discount: 15 percent for all registrations before launch; no count cap
accessibility: keyboard arrows and Home on scene
logo_lighting: Directional light remains on the front at the hero; scroll progressively raises the light direction to illuminate the backprint from above.
drop_status: Full-screen entrance: decorative counter eases to 72% while the scene loads, then the same bar travels onto the marked lower torso position above the pouch pocket (64% down the garment canvas). It stays at 72%. Scene readiness gates the reveal with a timeout fallback; this number is not network progress. Reduced motion skips travel. After arrival, a narrow pulsing light sweeps left to right across the track every 3.4 seconds; the 72% fill and number remain fixed. Disabled for reduced motion.
visible_controls: Move the light / Swipe for light; Mehr entdecken links directly to the reveal endpoint. No visible slider.

wordmark.source: Higgsfield elephant and custom TENSA. lettering, composed as an SVG lockup with embedded monochrome raster artwork.
wordmark.lighting: Permanent warm-white visibility with an additional pointer-following highlight.

coming_soon: Below single-line invitation, three dots bounce sequentially in a continuous gentle rhythm; reduced-motion disables bounce.

intro_emblem.source: Image-generation extraction of the user-supplied flat elephant logo, with empty central banner
intro_emblem.presentation: Fades to 20% white behind a original, unstretched HTML TENSA. wordline. The blank banner border is masked away so only the elephant remains behind the text; fades away as the loading bar travels to the lower torso.
